hero.label: Made for Exa
hero.headline: I want to help Exa win the AI search market.
hero.subheadline: Exa is doing something genuinely new: rebuilding search from scratch for a world where AIs are the primary consumers of information. I came from selling AI tools at Copygen and running B2B digital campaigns at NextAfter, and I want to bring that pipeline-building and growth instinct to the team that is redefining how LLMs find the internet.

whyCompany.title: Search rebuilt for AIs is a once-in-a-decade infrastructure bet
whyCompany.body: Most search engines were designed for humans clicking links. Exa is building for a world where the query comes from a model, not a person, and that distinction unlocks an entirely different product surface. The fact that Exa indexes and serves at the scale of hundreds of billions of pages purpose-built for LLM consumption tells me this is serious infrastructure, not a wrapper.

whyCompany.title: Nvidia backing plus YC plus Singapore expansion means real velocity right now
whyCompany.body: Exa is not waiting around: NVIDIA backing, a YC S21 pedigree, and an international expansion to Singapore all signal a company accelerating into a market window that will not stay open forever. Hiring for growth at this exact moment means the person in this seat will help shape how developers and AI companies discover and adopt the product. That is the kind of leverage I want.

whyCompany.title: Cold outreach and B2B campaigns trained me to open doors fast
whyCompany.body: At Copygen I built outbound sequences from zero and helped land 15 to 20 paying clients using HubSpot and LinkedIn, so I know what it takes to move a developer-focused product from cold prospect to signed contract. At NextAfter I then layered on B2B digital marketing strategy, learning how to drive qualified pipeline through content and paid channels. Exa's growth challenge sits exactly at that intersection.

quote: Will built Exa because he believed search could be smarter than it was. I want to be the person who makes sure every developer building an AI product knows Exa exists and chooses it first.
